feeds.title: Wessex Tubas
feeds.description: Wessex Tubas was established by an experienced British tuba player, Jonathan Hodgetts, with the aim of bringing the pleasure of brass music-making to the masses. Starting small and with big ideas, after only a year, Wessex Tubas had grown enough for Jonathan to dedicate all of his time to the business and, in 2012, a distribution centre was opened in the USA; responding to increasing demand in the States.

feeds.title: Andrew Hitz Blog
feeds.description: Andrew Hitz is a former tuba player for Boston Brass as well as a soloist, professor, clinician, speaker, music business consultant and Co-Founder of Pedal Note Media. This blog is about the performance and pedagogy of music by Andrew himself.

feeds.title: Strictly Oompah
feeds.description: Marching through the history of the Sousaphone that belongs to the Tuba family of brass instruments. Follow to know more and to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: Jeremy Lewis, Tuba Blog
feeds.description: Jeremy Lewis teaches applied lessons to all tuba and euphonium majors at West Texas A&M University. He is the principal tubist with the Amarillo Symphony Orchestra. Follow this blog for online resources, lessons and tips about Tuba.

feeds.title: SmartMusic » Tuba
feeds.description: SmartMusic is a music learning software for educators and students. We aim to develop solutions that transform how music is taught, learned, and performed. Follow for updates about Tuba on SmartMusic.
